snippet.title: Path of Exile 1: Curse of the Allflame Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover sunken artefacts and battle the horrors of the deep in Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame. 

Our July expansion introduces a new challenge league, significant improvements to Abyss and Legion, the return of the Mercenaries of Trarthus, another new Ascendancy Class for the Scion, an all-new endgame system, and much more!

https://www.pathofexile.com/allflame
